title: react-spring wobbly
description: Lò xo rung rinh, vượt khoảng 21 % rồi dừng sau 0.65 giây; cho nhân vật, sticker.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 1 on tension 180, friction 12, mass 1 (damping ratio 0.45): 20.8 % overshoot, within 1 % by ~650 ms. Kit form: springk(180, 12) over 0.65 s. Rule: jiggly; characters and stickers. Small demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: tension (180) · friction (12) · duration (0.65 s). react-spring's wobbly (180 / 12): about 21 % past, settled by ~0.65 s; characters and stickers.
